topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 62 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 14 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (asset, upgradeableproxy, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
